description: This Java class 'URLConnector' manages HTTP/HTTPS URL connections with support for SSL configurations, timeouts, and trusted/untrusted certificates. It provides static methods to open connections with various SSL trust levels and handles connection threading and cleanup.

classes.name: URLConnector
classes.description: A utility class for managing URL connections with SSL support, timeouts, and threading.

methods.name: openConnection
methods.description: Opens a URLConnection with specified timeout, SSL settings, and optional client certificate.

methods.name: openUntrustedConnection
methods.description: Opens a URLConnection that trusts untrusted SSL certificates.
